## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck:examples`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck:viewer`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck:site`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build` / `npm run build:lib` when changing distribution output
- [ ] Shader, sampling or post-processing changes: compare fixed-seed, fixed-sample `renderer.getRawOutput()` pixels before and after on real WebGPU and WebGL 2 GPUs, and describe the results
- [ ] Third-party code: include a source comment, notice and compatible license text, or confirm none was introduced

Contributor rules: [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md).
